title: IST launches with Agoric mainnet-1
description: Agoric mainnet-1 launched with Inter Protocol contracts enabling IST minting and interchain use.
notes: Exact day follows Agoric's dated mainnet-1 announcement.

title: Inter Protocol sunset concludes
description: The phased Inter Protocol wind-down concluded after minting cessation, vault closure work, and transition away from IST protocol roles.
notes: The proposal planned June 30 T0 shutdown; the official community update on 2 July states the sunsetting concluded.

title: USN launches on NEAR
description: Decentral Bank launched USN with NEAR and USDT reserve support and on-chain minting.
notes: Launch date follows the official announcement.

title: USN v2 shifts to USDT backing
description: USN v2 changed the initial model so minting and redemption used USDT at 1:1 during Phase I.
notes: Model transition, not a new stablecoin identity.

title: USN enters controlled wind-down
description: Decentral Bank permanently stopped new USN minting and directed holders to protection and swap routes.
notes: Wind-down date follows the official issuer message and protection-program announcement.
